facts.fact: The museum is in Recoleta and holds Argentine, Latin American and international art.
Its current building was formerly associated with the city water supply.
Artists represented in the collection include Antonio Berni, Cándido López and Benito Quinquela Martín.

title: Turismo Buenos Aires — Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes
